sections.content: HTML5 validation attributes — required, pattern, min, max, minlength — give instant feedback before submission, but they are UX sugar, not security.
The Constraint Validation API (checkValidity(), validationMessage) lets scripts react to validity states; :valid/:invalid CSS styles reflect them live.
Key points: novalidate disables browser checks when you handle them in JS, always pair client checks with server validation.
